content.content:
User asks: "Which Formula 1 Grand Prix races have been hosted in Asia/Middle East and which driver has the most wins on each of these tracks?" Need to produce list of Asian/Middle East Grand Prix locations (countries/circuits) that have hosted F1 races, and for each track, the driver with most wins (including number of wins). Should be up-to-date as of now (2025). Need to include all races up to 2025 season. Also note that some tracks have had multiple Grand Prix names (e.g., Singapore, Bahrain, Abu Dhabi, Japan, China, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, etc). Also include former Asian tracks like Malaysia (Sepang), India (Buddh International Circuit), Saudi Arabian Jeddah Corniche Circuit (since 2021), Qatar (Lusail International Circuit, debut 2023), also maybe Vietnam (Hanoi) was scheduled but cancelled, not actually held. Should we include tracks that never held a race? Probably not, only those that have hosted. Also include Middle East: Bahrain International Circuit (Bahrain GP), Abu Dhabi Yas Marina Circuit (Abu Dhabi GP), Jeddah Corniche Circuit (Saudi Arabian GP), Lusail (Qatar GP). Also maybe Dubai? Not yet. Also include Japan (Suzuka, Fuji). Also include Shanghai International Circuit (Chinese GP). Also Singapore (Marina Bay). Also maybe Malaysia (Sepang, Malaysian GP). Also maybe Indian (Buddh). Also possibly the "Korea" (Korea GP at Yeongam, 2010, 2011) - that's Asia. Also "Azerbaijan" (Baku City Circuit) is technically transcontinental, but often considered Europe/Asia? It's in the Caucasus region, partially in Asia; maybe include. But user said Asia/Middle East, so Azerbaijan (Baku) is in Asia (Caucasus). Also "Turkey" is partly Asia but usually considered Europe for F1; but we might exclude. Also "Saudi Arabia" already.

Need driver with most wins on each track. For each circuit, compile driver with most wins (ties? we can note). Provide number of wins.

We need up-to-date as of 2025, meaning after 2024 season (2025 not yet). So include data up to 2024.

We'll need to retrieve data. Use function delegate to get list of circuits in Asia/Middle East and driver win counts. Could query a helper. Let's craft instruction.
